description:
Adds a new built-in plugin (chat_branching) that lets users branch a chat from any message. Clicking the new fork button (next to copy/speak) on any message — user, agent, response, error, process step, etc. — creates a new chat with the log history up to that point and switches to it.

### Implementation:

`plugin.yaml` — always-enabled built-in plugin
`branch_chat.py` — serializes the source context, trims the log at the target LogItem.no, and deserializes into a new context with a fresh ID. Handles `LOG_SIZE=1000` truncation alignment by matching the original no field in serialized log entries, with a 0-based fallback for post-reload contexts.
`inject-branch-buttons.js` — uses the `set_messages_after_loop` JS extension hook to inject a branch button into every `.step-action-buttons` container. No core code changes required.
